definitions.gloss: live-action adaptation; making into a live-action film or series
definitions.explanation: The process of adapting an animated work, manga, novel, or video game into a live-action film or television series with real actors.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{実写化|じっしゃか}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That manga was adapted into a live-action film.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実写化|じっしゃか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A live-action adaptation of the popular anime was announced.

examples.japanese: {実写化|じっしゃか}⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{賛否両論|さんぴりょうろん}だった。
examples.english: Fan reactions to the live-action adaptation were mixed.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{実写|じっしゃ}→実写：12271_jissha⟧ means "real photography" or "live action" (as opposed to animation), and ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ means "turning into." The word is very common in entertainment news and among anime/manga fans. Can be used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb ({実写化|じっしゃか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実写化|じっしゃか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make a live-action adaptation)
- {実写化|じっしゃか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決定|けってい}する→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧ (a live-action adaptation is confirmed)
- {実写版|じっしゃばん} (live-action version)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦アニメ{化|か}→アニメ化：23065_animeka⟧: anime adaptation — adapting a work into anime, the reverse direction
- ⟦{映画化|えいがか}→映画化：23773_eigaka⟧: film adaptation — adapting into a movie (not specifically live-action)
